test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct option for the Direct Speech conversion of the sentence below.

The primatolagist pointed out that grooming behaviour would diminish if the troop hierarchy were destabilised.

options.text: The primatologist said, "Grooming behaviour would diminish if the troop hierarchy were destabilised.
The primatologist said, "Grooming behaviour will be diminished if the troop hierarchy is destabilised.”
The primatologist said, "If the troop hierarchy had been destabilised, grooming behaviour would have diminished."
The primatologist said, "Were the troop hierarchy destabilised, grooming behaviour must diminish."

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** The primatologist pointed out that grooming behaviour would diminish if the troop hierarchy were destabilised.
 
• **Key Conversions (Reverse Process):**
 
 
• **Conditionals in Reported Speech:**
 
 
• The sentence contains a **Type 2 Conditional** (hypothetical or unreal condition), indicated by "would diminish" and "were destabilised.&
